prior_witness_seen: Worlds A and B and first/last phase-bin perturbation were published in PR239; this new contrast is selected post-v0 and is not blind ecological discovery.
observed_summary: All three pairwise margins (site×branch, site×phase, branch×phase) from original 2×2×6 world A as one realized exact integer contingency table.
frozen_target: Early-site log odds ratio of (falling vs rising rate) at FIRST phase bin relative to LAST bin: log[(F_early,first/R_early,first)/(F_early,last/R_early,last)]; odds ratio exactly 1 indicates no early-vs-late shape shift.
required_checks: all admissible strictly positive integer tables enumerated without sampling
all reconstructed tables preserve every frozen pairwise margin and total
both prior World A and World B present in fiber
min log odds ratio <0, max log odds ratio >0, and at least one exact zero
report min/max odds ratio and log ratio, maximizing/minimizing full table, counts by shift sign
do not call the identification interval a statistical confidence interval
do not infer that the joint distribution of all overlapping pairwise-margin measurements is identical under sampling
no real biological, camera or device event records accessed
